governance.note: All recommendations below are exploratory selections derived from the 40-question Stage 04 benchmark using AI-generated pooled relevance judgments and Controlled Agent Generation. They are NOT independently validated production settings.

caveats: Does NOT win every metric: NO_RAG Correctness (0.9688) exceeds A4; A1 leads Faithfulness (0.9250) and Citation Accuracy (0.8500); B4 leads Pooled Recall@5 (0.3509) and has 0% embedding truncation.
Highest warm retrieval latency at pool=120 (P95 = 3,693.1 ms) and 43.2% MiniLM embedding truncation.
Pareto-optimal for CPU-only / strict latency budgets; zero GPU VRAM required.
Vulnerable to lexical mismatch, paraphrases, and Vietnamese unaccented queries (accent_insensitive=false).
Context fragmentation (median 112 chars, 2.1x chunk count) reduces nDCG@5 (-20.7%, Holm p=0.001) and EvRecall@15 (-17.4%, Holm p=0.0035) relative to A4.
Requires ~1.5x longer cold BM25 build (15.5s vs 10.7s) and 2.1x theoretical vector storage.

practical_balanced_exploratory.protocol_warning: Pool=30 latency originates from Protocol 5 (640 single-pass calls) and budget=2048 sensitivity originates from an exploratory n=10 subset; both must be validated on an independent held-out set and live production stack before deployment.

future_work_not_implemented_in_stage05: Enable accent_insensitive=true (or dual diacritic-aware + folded BM25 fields) to remediate the 0.0% Vietnamese unaccented typo failure (-0.6667 EvRecall@5).
Migrate from QdrantLocal SQLite (~461-645 ms/search leg) to Qdrant Server (HNSW) and evaluate persistent/async BM25 cache refresh to eliminate 300s TTL rebuild spikes.
Refine structure_adaptive chunking with minimum semantic unit merging (target 80-120 tokens) to combine 0% embedding truncation with lower context fragmentation.
Conduct human domain-expert ground-truth validation (moving human_validated=false -> true) and live Groq + HTTP E2E benchmarking once API credentials and production Qdrant indexing are authorized.

source_stage04_recommendations.methodology_note: Objective multi-criteria summary at K=5 and K=15 (candidate_top_k=120); no arbitrary composite weights. Exploratory selection on benchmark set (not held-out validated).
